quest_template.LogDescription: 'Defeat God-King Skovald in the Halls of Valor and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.'
quest_template.QuestDescription:
'The Felskorn may be broken, but the head of the beast yet lives. The God-King will still vie for the Aegis if left unchecked.

You, who have completed trials upon trials, must not let this come to pass. You must claim the Aegis over Skovald's broken bones!

The Halls of Valor await!'

quest_template.LogDescription: 'Secure the Aegis of Aggramar in the Chamber of the Guardian in Dalaran.'
quest_template.QuestDescription: 'Now that it\'s out of the hands of the Legion, the Aegis should be brought back to Dalaran for safekeeping while the hunt continues for the rest of the Pillars of Creation.\n\nIt should be safe in the central portal chamber until the time comes when it is needed.'
